subject: Request to substitute an ABS DWV alternate in lieu of the no-hub cast-iron soil piping

messages.text: We're proposing an ABS DWV alternate in lieu of the no-hub cast-iron soil piping specified in Section 22 13 16 and want sign-off before we order material. No rush -- please take a look whenever it's convenient. The substitution may affect the plumbing fixture budget depending on the manufacturer. This substitution will not affect the domestic water pressure test date. A response by the end of the day would let us keep the order on track.
